attackers_goals: Attackers may exploit server components or misconfigurations to access arbitrary sensitive files on the web server.
description: The endpoint received suspicious HTTP parameters via an HTTP request, which may indicate attempts to exploit server components or web shell activity.
investigative_actions: Inspect the legitimacy of the URI path and the parameters values sent to the server. Ensure that the rare URI is not a legitimate result of routine development actions on the web server.
name: Suspicious HTTP parameters detected
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
